title: English Opening
intro: 1.c4 grabs the d5 square from the side. Against 1...e5 it is like a Sicilian with colours reversed and an extra move for White.

lessons.title: The King's English
lessons.summary: c4, Nc3, g3 and Bg2: pressure on d5 and the long diagonal.

steps.text: 1.c4 controls d5 without putting a pawn in the centre yet. White's plan: Nc3 and a bishop on g2, all aiming at d5 and the long light diagonal.
If Black takes the centre with ...d5, White swaps it off with cxd5 and the bishop on g2 rakes the long diagonal towards b7 and a8.
Set up the English as White.
steps.hint: c4, Nc3, g3, then take on d5 and put the bishop on g2.
steps.ifWrong: Follow the plan: c4, Nc3, g3, cxd5, Bg2.
steps.ifRight: The bishop on g2 already hits the knight on d5 and the queenside.
